fields.title: Assess Surge Readiness
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Autoscaling: threshold 65%, scale-up time 120 s, current load 45%, headroom 35%. A surge doubling the load in 90 seconds is expected.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: no. Doubling in 90 seconds is faster than the 120-second scale-up time; 35% headroom covers a one-third growth, not a double. For the first two minutes, the system operates at current capacity under double load. Solution: manually raise the minimum in advance to a level covering the expected peak, plus prepare to shed load on secondary scenarios. Rule of thumb: compare surge speed to scale-up time.
